Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Matias Churquina
Message:
fix: hardening de seguridad post-escaneo PT-22 + soporte Cloudflare Tunnel

Remediaciones del informe de vulnerabilidades:

- nginx.conf: headers de seguridad (CSP, X-Frame-Options, nosniff,
  Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) + server_tokens off.
  Resuelve 3 MEDIUM de ZAP (CSP, anti-clickjacking, MIME sniffing)
  y el LOW de disclosure de version.
- compose.yaml: haproxy 2.9-alpine -> 3.0-alpine (EOL, causaba
  crash exit 134), pin de imagenes :latest (prometheus v3,
  node-exporter v1, cadvisor v0.55.1, postgres-exporter v0.17.1,
  nextcloud 31-apache, glpi 11, mysql 8.4), no-new-privileges y
  cap_drop ALL en backend/frontend.
- npm audit fix (non-breaking): frontend 47 -> 19 vulns, backend
  parcial. Las restantes requieren upgrades major (documentadas).
- Nuevo servicio cloudflared para Named Tunnel (TUNNEL_TOKEN en
  .env), subdominios apuntan a servicios internos de redtpfinal.
- .env.example con todas las variables requeridas (sin secretos)
  + excepcion en .gitignore.
- SERVIDOR_CONFIG.md: documentacion del Named Tunnel y Access.
